milestones.claim: The two execution-plan documents are audited against current CLI/source behavior and every capability is classified as implemented, partial, future, missing, or intentionally out of scope.
milestones.doneMeans: A committed audit artifact or plan section lists the document commitments and current evidence, and CHK-001 verification evidence proves the classification is mechanically checked.

milestones.claim: Global Control Plane status reporting accurately exposes implemented, partial, unavailable, and future capabilities without treating command existence as full DoD completion.
milestones.doneMeans: global_control_status or focused diagnostics show the status of proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, tierCCleanup, runtime, consumption, readiness, and queue lanes with document-aligned semantics.

milestones.claim: Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories are represented as durable experiment-batch exceptions rather than ordinary duplicate cleanup targets, while malformed entries remain visible.
milestones.doneMeans: queue_governance_status groups matching Tier-C stories as experiment-batch-exception and leaves malformed/nonmatching records as cleanup-required; no lifecycle readiness is waived.

milestones.claim: Runtime closure hard-block rollout exists for safe high-risk operations such as wrong authoritative cwd, stale locks, dirty phase advances, and worktree authority drift.
milestones.doneMeans: Runtime enforcement is configured, documented, and tested with rollback behavior; read-only status remains available and does not replace lifecycle truth.

milestones.claim: Queue governance guard blocks accidental duplicate/superseded mutations without destroying experiment evidence or granting lifecycle completion.
milestones.doneMeans: Queue mutation paths are guarded by explicit policy/lock/evidence, experiment exceptions remain preserved, and malformed experiment records stay visible for cleanup.

milestones.claim: Proof Admissibility enforcement is rolled out for high-risk consumers without overclaiming Authority Server production completion.
milestones.doneMeans: Configured high-risk proof consumers enforce admissibility or explicitly report unavailable/future status with user-approved shrinkage; DONE_REQUIRED, review assurance, handoff proof refs, and Authority-facing consumers have focused coverage.

milestones.claim: The story validates B-5082 by passing ProofStory gate, intent coverage, REVIEW completeness, DONE intent equivalence, delivery, done-required validation, and review assurance over the final material.
milestones.doneMeans: Final closure evidence shows all seven milestones covered or explicitly sliced/shrunk with approval, and all required ProofStory/lifecycle gates pass before DONE.
